s: Which one of the following correctly describes the origin of the slogan “Quit India”?
o: The phrase was suggested by Mahatma Gandhi in Harijan in April 1942, while its coinage is generally credited to Yusuf Meherally
It was coined by Mahatma Gandhi in Young India in 1942
It was coined by Jawaharlal Nehru at the Wardha meeting in July 1942
It was first used by Subhas Chandra Bose in a broadcast from Germany
x: Gandhi suggested the phrase in Harijan in April 1942, whereas Yusuf Meherally is generally credited with coining it. Young India had ceased publication in 1932.
tq: Distinguish the person who suggested a phrase from the person generally credited with coining it.
